envelope.reason: the stance and purview guards conflict on routing by name

payload.title: stance guard reads routing by name as a dispatch echo
payload.body: Now that the judge answers, the stance pre-call guard denied the architect routing ready units by name to implementers, calling it a dispatch echo with no distilled intent. The architect role routes a unit by name alone and never writes its spec, and the purview guard denies a dispatch that carries a self-written spec. The two guards now pull in opposite directions on the loop's central act. Workaround used: the dispatch names each unit and states its shard's what and why in the design's words, which is the architect's own writing, not a spec. The stance rubric should recognise a routed unit name, with its shard stated, as a substantive dispatch.
